Claim 1 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, wherein the non-native compartment is formed by the expression of a polynucleotide encoding the at least one BMC polypeptide.

Claim 8 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 any preceding claim wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides, including polypeptides that are heterologous to the host cell.

Claim 12 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacteria-derived microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide.

Claim 21 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product wherein the method further comprises: the step of utilizing the at least one enzyme to produce a desired product from the substrate. 

Claim 26 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the method further comprises isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments, wherein the isolation process is done using affinity chromatography based on the presence of an affinity tag in at least a portion of the non-native compartments.
